roots.baseline_declaration_text:
func TestConfirmationRequiresTheAppliedTargetIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	f := newRolloutFixture(t)
	target := rolloutTarget("0.80.0")
	f.advance(target, "confirm")
	f.deferActions = true
	node := f.record().Node
	status := f.statuses[node]
	status.ActionID, status.Pending = CommandID(f.record().ID, "confirm"), ""
	status.AppliedTargetHash = Hash(rolloutTarget("0.80.1"))
	f.statuses[node] = status
	if err := f.tick(target); err != nil || f.record().Phase != "confirm" || !f.drained[node] || slices.Contains(f.effects, "return:"+node) {
		t.Fatalf("confirmation for another target released the node: record=%+v effects=%v error=%v", f.record(), f.effects, err)
	}
}

				switch invalid {
				case "not-missing":
					status.Missing = false

rollout.trace: root -> newRolloutFixture/rolloutTarget -> advance/tick -> freshly constructed Reconciler.Tick -> fixture Load/Save/Status/Preflight/Drain/Healthy/Return/Send -> f.apply. Journal is a []byte field serialized with JSON; status/drain/effects are maps/slices. Production Hash/CommandID/version/ULID helpers are local. Clock/entropy used for identity is incidental, not a materially asserted service/runtime boundary. No production KV/NATS/worker/LB/NetBird/OCI/TerraBase implementation is delegated to by fixture callbacks.

	t             *testing.T

type Reconciler struct {
	Load      func(context.Context) (Record, error)
	Save      func(context.Context, Record) error
	Status    func(context.Context, string) (Status, error)
	Preflight func(context.Context, string) error
	Drain     func(context.Context, string) error
	Healthy   func(context.Context, string, Status, time.Time) error

}
